output.summary: A perennial climbing legume originating in the mountains of Central America. Most varieties have red flowers and multicoloured seeds, although some are white. Its seeds, young pods and, in Mesoamerica, starchy roots are eaten; the beans contain a toxic protein and must be cooked thoroughly.
output.edibilityNote: Seeds are eaten fresh or dried, young pods whole, and roots in Mesoamerica; beans must be cooked thoroughly because they contain a toxic protein.
